ShouldStartAtBottomOfDrawPile.maps_to: nothing in the sim. Its only consumer is CombatManager.cs:657-664, the turn-1 pass that moves every such card to the BOTTOM of the draw pile before the opening hand is drawn
ShouldStartAtBottomOfDrawPile.issue: The sim's docstring calls this 'cosmetic and not modeled' (enchantments.py:249); it is not cosmetic -- it changes the draw pile's order for the whole combat and, for Imbued specifically, is what keeps the card OUT of the opening hand so that the AutoPrePlay auto-play is the only way it resolves. The MISSING PASS itself is already recorded as audits/seam/turn_structure.json step 21 / guard G14 (rule 3: not re-verdicted, same verdict); this entry records that Imbued is the only implementer in the game and therefore the whole of G14's blast radius, and that the sim's rationale for skipping it is wrong.

ShowAmount.rationale: presentation only: read solely by EnchantmentModel.DynamicExtraCardText (EnchantmentModel.cs:60-81) and the card-UI nodes; no game-state reader. Out of scope per the shared contract's 'presentation/animation' waiver.

CanEnchantCardType.maps_to: ImbuedEnchantment.can_enchant (enchantments.py:255-259) -- `card_type == CardType.SKILL`, matching Imbued.cs:15-18. Enchantment.can_enchant (enchantments.py:51-61) + the subclass override. Base CanEnchant (EnchantmentModel.cs:273-294) rejects CardType 4/5/6 (Status/Curse/Quest), then CanEnchantCardType, then an Unplayable card whose pile is PileType.Deck, then a card that already has a (non-stackable) enchantment. The sim folds CanEnchantCardType into each subclass's own can_enchant and replaces the pile-qualified Unplayable test with an unconditional `not card.is_playable` -- equal in practice because every ported grant enchants a DECK card (probe `grants`).

AfterAutoPrePlayPhaseEntered.issue: The sim adds a guard C# does not have. Imbued.cs:20-25 is `if (player == Card.Owner && player.PlayerCombatState.TurnNumber <= 1) await CardCmd.AutoPlay(ctx, Card, null);` -- NO pile check, so the card is auto-played from wherever it is, which by CombatManager.cs:657-664 is the BOTTOM OF THE DRAW PILE. The sim requires `self.card in player.hand`, so it fires only when the card happens to be dealt into the opening five -- the very outcome the C# pass exists to prevent. EXECUTED (`py tools/audit/enchantment_probes.py imbued`): over seeds 0-19 with a 10-card deck holding one Imbued Defend, the sim's auto-play fired on 7 of 20 openings; the game fires on 20 of 20. LIVE: Imbued is granted by the ported Electric Shrymp relic (relics/electric_shrymp.py:17-21), the sim's auto_play_card searches the draw pile too (combat.py:526-534) so the hand guard is the only thing stopping it, and turn <= 1 is reached in every combat. Distinct from turn_structure G8 (which owns the missing AutoPrePlay PHASE, i.e. WHEN the hook fires) and from G14 (which owns the missing pile pass): this is the hook BODY carrying an extra condition.
